This model boasts a robust architecture that supports multi-agent interactions, making it highly versatile for a wide range of applications. With its capabilities in text, function calling, JSON mode, streaming, and structured outputs, developers can leverage xAI: Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent for complex tasks such as chat, text generation, coding, analysis, and summarization.

Its knowledge cutoff is 2023-12, ensuring that its training data is current up to that point.
